motion.name: drawer-enter
motion.purpose: Reveal evidence without delaying the main task

components.name: Supported Period
components.description: Compact evidence cell in a 14-day interval
components.css: .ds-period-cell { background: #e8f4ed; color: #202a28; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 10px; font: 500 12px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-period-cell:hover, .ds-period-cell:focus-visible { border-color: #177a6c; outline: 2px solid #177a6c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search
components.css: .ds-search { background: white; border: 1px solid #d5ddd4; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; color: #202a28; font: 400 12px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #177a6c; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A working leaderboard, not a decorative infographic. Register-like density enables comparison of seven periods, with source-linked details one click away.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Reserve teal fills for supported outcomes; never use amber as a negative performance grade.

dos: Keep the strongest visible source links close to every claim.
Show unscored contributions without equating them to no impact.
donts: Use review load in the impact score.
Present the attention mark as an employee-performance verdict.
